replies.author: AtditC
replies.body:
Nah, yml is just a programming language, it doesn't "need to be updated".
The plugin (Avicore.jar) reads all stuff in a yml file, example:
team: lime: (create virtual team lime)
 spawn: 783.5,76,842.5,0,0 (tp a player at these coordinates)
monuments: a: 263.5,73,542.5,0,0 (the monuments will be counted if the block on this coordination disappers/if an enemy mines it.)
                     b: 183.5,73,642.5,0,0
         
etc...

 and will create a virtual CTM match. Ivy just has to expand/add more code in this Avicore/DTM plugin, there is no yml which needs to be updated, no, and 4 Teams would be supported too.

I hope you understand what I tried to explain...c;

replies.author: Netuxx
replies.body:
O-O, It's been a long time since i last posted sometime here.

So I would say that 3+ Teams mini-games that requires to "capture" an objective ain't possible.
Imagine the case of 3 teams; a, b and c:
  • a captures (in this case mines) two objectives from c
  • Later, before a captures the last objective from c, b captures it.
  • More later the same happens with the other 2 teams...
Current capture logic says that the team with all captures from the other(s) team(s) wins the match, but in the case of more than 2 teams the logic will fail and the game will just continue until it runs out of time.

Even though there is a way to fix this logic: Basically once your time captured an objective it regenerates instantly and will not be visible anymore for your teammates. So the logic changes to the first team on getting all objectives presented, objectives will not longer be separated by Teams.

I hope you understand what I'm trying to say c:
